claims.exact_statement: For each finite a>=0 and 0<=b<1, universal GU(a,b) is equivalent to GU(a,b) on the fixed slice E F=1/2 even when the slice estimate is allowed a uniform additive terminal e_N=o(N). The converse uses T(q^{tensor t}) and the exact identities U(T(q))=1+U(q)/2, I(T(q))=1+I(q)/2, G(T(q))=G(q)/2+kappa(Eq), with bounded kappa.
hypotheses: Finite uniform cubes and genuine sign-valued Boolean functions
A uniform sequence e_N with |e_N|/N tending to zero
Fresh uniform y,z in the embedding and disjoint tensor copies
proof_dependencies: U-universal tensor additivity and GU-to-U restriction induction
Fair-activation U formula, independently resubstituted in PROOF.md
claims.first_unproved_line: Prove FB-GU-o(N) for one finite a and b<1 on every Boolean function with expectation 1/2.
